repo_prior_art.cite: none; the completed Stat catalogue contains no PN/PS rare-factual-probability frontier.

published_prior_art.cite: TianWu2025 proves regular efficient PN/PS inference; CuellarKennedy2020 treats a projected conditional PC; ZhangWangMiao2025 treats generally partial-ID PN bounds. None gives this monotone point-ID triangular shell with uniform O((nr_n)^(-1/2)) diameter.

per_theorem_calls.label: Theorem: shellwise minimax expected-diameter lower bound

published_prior_art.cite: GleserHwang1987 supplies the general finite-expected-diameter impossibility mechanism, but not a monotone PN/PS two-point submodel verified to lie in the identical learned Gaussian shell.
ChernozhukovNeweySingh2022 studies regular and localized regression functionals, but does not characterize necessity of these directional PN/PS rare-score learning inequalities.

structure_flags.label: thm:gaussian-frontier and thm:gaussian-lower
structure_flags.one_line: The two load-bearing, non-routine matched-frontier claims are labelled theorems despite status to-prove; reclassify them as conjectures.

novelty_flags.label: thm:gaussian-frontier and thm:gaussian-lower
novelty_flags.one_line: Related work omits ZhangWangMiao2025, the close public theorem-text preprint on PN inference; position its partial-ID/margin setting explicitly against this monotone point-ID rare-shell claim.

soundness_flags.label: ass:score-information and def:base-and-gaussian-shells
soundness_flags.one_line: The score-information assumption quantifies over M_G,n^d even though that shell is itself defined by including the assumption, creating a circular membership condition; state it pointwise for each P_n and let the shell collect laws satisfying it.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Matched Gaussian-shell frontier
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The upper/lower comparison is conditional on the identical directional shells, including score-information comparability and the displayed rare-learning inequalities.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniform coverage and matching O((nr_n)^(-1/2)) expected diameter only over M_G,n^d(r_n), separately for PN and PS.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Zhang, Wang, and Miao (2025), identify its partial-ID/margin theorem precisely, and state why monotonicity plus a vanishing factual stratum creates a distinct point-ID problem.
Rewrite ass:score-information as a property of an individual observed law; if possible replace its lower variance half with primitive interior/nondegeneracy conditions that imply it.
Relabel the two matched-frontier results as conjectures and sharpen the open question into a converse under a named least-favourable Hölder perturbation family.

recommended_next_step: Revise this angle: repair the circular shell condition, add the missing direct PN-inference comparator, and relabel the open matched-frontier kernel as conjectural before advancing.
